method: Read the named current Go code, tests and parent-authored actual checker evidence. References identify related implemented/tested slices and explicit gaps, not clause-wide support. Capability values remain not-tested; no existence-based upgrade or official Reading System execution is inferred.

rows.gap: Related current ZIP writer puts mimetype first; the named test checks actual first local/central headers and resource bytes. This is the existing pack slice, not a complete OCF/version/profile or five-dimensional conformance assessment.
Related pack test independently checks the literal 20 US-ASCII application/epub+zip bytes. No full input-profile/negative-encoding or renderer assessment is claimed by this reference.
Related pack test checks exact 20-byte mimetype payload without padding; reference does not prove all input rejection or all five capabilities for this clause.
Related pack test checks exact US-ASCII mimetype bytes, so its tested output has no BOM. A reference is not broad accepted-input or no-op preservation evidence.
Related raw-header test checks Stored compression and zero flags for mimetype. No new generation, encrypted-input support or complete OCF compliance is inferred.
Related pack test checks zero local-header extra length and empty central-header Extra. Future profile/fidelity assessment remains separate from this existing tested pack slice.

Existing rootfile parsing, path resolution and explicit CLI selection are related; test preserves resource bytes. Not all URL grammar, XML encodings or profiles are assessed, and explicit CLI selection is not the Reading System first-rootfile default.
Current publication loading checks/selects the OPF media-type rootfile; the test supplies that value. This does not claim a clause-specific exhaustive malformed media-type or schema negative corpus.

Known gap: the existing CLI multi-rootfile fixture permits explicitly selecting an EPUB2 package alongside EPUB3, rather than proving the publication's same-version MUST. Preserve selection behavior; conformance checks and any version/profile policy belong to the assigned later batch.

Existing namespace/token selection and missing/ambiguous navigation diagnostics are related static slices. Legal DOCTYPE/UTF16 and the complete nav vocabulary/authoring rules remain T1/T4 gaps; no activation or rendered order is tested.

Actual pinned EPUBCheck5.3.0 evidence: standalone and inline SVG a succeeds; defs/title epub:type is rejected with RSC-005. This is six complete EPUB samples, not exhaustive SVG renderable-element coverage, parser support, rendering or a known whole-spec checker baseline.

Related actual first-viewport XHTML fixture names viewport and runs pinned EPUBCheck. SPACE/TAB/LF/CR succeed; FF and NBSP produce distinct expected diagnostics. The samples do not exhaust name normalization, duplicate-meta handling or the complete viewport grammar.

Actual narrow XML-whitespace separator samples cover valid width/height grammar in the first fixed-layout viewport; illegal FF is rejected at XML parsing and NBSP is not a property separator. No claim of exhaustive grammar, engine layout, RS behavior or exact overall REC checker baseline.
